description: Shows your unread messages. With wait (seconds), waits up to that long for a new message (for real-time conversation). Messages already delivered in another tool's header are not unread; when there are no new ones, recently received ones are noted for reference.

agent.description: Your display name, shown to other agents. Subagents must always set it. Default "claude-d26d".

slot.description: Browser slot 1-30. "3", "slot 3", "browser 3" → 3. If the user gives a port like 14052, subtract 14049.

wait.description: Max seconds to wait for a new message; returns as soon as one arrives (use this instead of repeatedly checking the page while waiting for another agent)

name: slot_inbox
title: Check messages
